report:
**Sample adequacy**
132 white cells on 147 fields (15 fields without white cell) — sufficient for differential. 1341 red cells (indicative) and 71 platelets counted.

**Differential — types outside indicative adult ranges**
Neutrophils 19.7% [40-75], lymphocytes 18.2% [20-45], monocytes 25.0% [2-10], eosinophils 15.2% [1-6], basophils 20.5% [0-2], ig 1.5% [0-1], erythroblasts 0.0% [0-0]. Six of seven types outside ranges — overall pattern unusual; check slide quality and field selection before using differential.

**Review list**
15 cells marked for review. Flagged to open first (6):
- high: cell 84 (ig) and cell 42 (ig) — rare type with second-opinion disagreement
- high: cell 40 (monocyte, conf. 0.58) — low confidence with disagreement
- normal: cell 100 (neutrophil), cell 58 (neutrophil), cell 19 (lymphocyte) — second-opinion disagreement
9 additional marked cells remain to review.

**Limits**
Second-opinion model is generalist: 65% on single cells, weak on ig/erythroblasts vs classifier 97.6%; red cells undercounted on crowded fields (count indicative); reference ranges are indicative adult ranges, lab's own ranges prevail.

known_limits: The second opinion model is a generalist: 65 % right on single PBC cells, weak on ig and erythroblasts (experiment 01). The classifier is 97.6 % right on the same data (experiment 05).
Red cells are undercounted on crowded fields (experiment 14); the red cell count is indicative.
Reference ranges are indicative adult ranges; the lab's own ranges prevail.

second_opinions.reasoning:
The central nucleated cell shows a round hyperchromatic nucleus with coarse chromatin and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm without granules consistent with a nucleated red cell.
LABEL: erythroblast

Enlarged nucleated cell with a dark bi-lobed/band, horseshoe-shaped nucleus and pale cytoplasm with fine lilac neutrophilic granules consistent with neutrophil lineage, band/metamyelocyte stage.

LABEL: neutrophil

The central cell is large with abundant pale blue-grey vacuolated cytoplasm and an eccentric oval nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin consistent with a monocyte.
LABEL: monocyte

The central cell shows a dense hyperchromatic round nucleus with very high N/C ratio and scant pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm without lobation or specific granules.

LABEL: lymphocyte

The central cell is large with an irregular, folded nucleus and abundant pale gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm indicating a monocytic lineage. 
LABEL: monocyte

Large cell with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm and a folded bilobed kidney-shaped nucleus lacking coarse granules indicates a monocyte.
LABEL: monocyte

Large cell with a segmented bilobed nucleus and cytoplasm filled with coarse pink-orange granules consistent with eosinophilic differentiation.
LABEL: eosinophil

Large cell with abundant light blue cytoplasm and a kidney/indented nucleus with loose chromatin favored over lymphocyte. 
LABEL: monocyte

The central nucleated cell shows a dense irregular nucleus with a high N/C ratio and intensely basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm without eosinophilic/basophilic granules or segmentation.
LABEL: lymphocyte

The central cell is large with an indented bilobed nucleus with condensed chromatin and abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm without eosinophilic/basophilic granules consistent with a monocyte.
LABEL: monocyte

Central cell has high N:C ratio with round, coarse condensed nucleus and a thin rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm without neutrophilic granules or lobation, consistent with small lymphocyte.
LABEL: lymphocyte
